method: Independent arithmetic expressions compared with calculation outputs. The published Appendix K example is recorded separately.

cases.name: Flat roof catchment area
cases.source_basis: Clause 3.4.3.1 plan area, including any contributing gutters.

cases.name: Single-slope eaves roof catchment
cases.source_basis: Independent trigonometric evaluation of the stated area-factor equation.

cases.name: Australian roofed-area design flow
cases.source_basis: Clause 5.4.6 coefficient 1.0 x area x intensity / 3600.

cases.name: Pervious runoff coefficient
cases.source_basis: 1.0 x (0.0133 x 44.4 - 0.233), with no soil adjustment.

cases.name: Pervious runoff coefficient with clay adjustment
cases.source_basis: Table 5.4.6(A) multiplier 0.85, then add 0.1 for clay soil.

cases.name: Pervious runoff coefficient with sandy-soil adjustment
cases.source_basis: Table 5.4.6(A) multiplier 1.05, then subtract 0.1 with a 0.1 floor.

cases.name: Roof, impervious, and pervious surface design flow
cases.source_basis: Clause 5.4.8 area-weighted sum using Australian coefficients 1.0 and 0.9 and Cp.

cases.name: Rectangular Manning channel capacity
cases.source_basis: Rectangular area and wetted perimeter evaluated independently in SI units.

cases.name: Trapezoidal Manning channel capacity
cases.source_basis: Trapezoid area and wetted perimeter evaluated independently, then Manning capacity.

cases.name: Sag-pit inlet capacity
cases.source_basis: 1600 x blockage factor x free perimeter x ponding depth to power 1.5.
